opened.message: The map is open in Maps Desktop

askClose.message: Close the Chrome tab every time a map opens in the app?

changeLater.message: You can change this later in the extension options.

optClose.message: Close the Chrome tab when a map opens in Maps Desktop

optPause.message: Click the extension button in the toolbar to pause or resume opening links in the app.

optSource.message: Maps Desktop and this extension on GitHub

missingText.message: It doesn’t seem to be installed on this Mac. This extension opens Google Maps links in Maps Desktop, a free Google Maps app for Mac.

installHow.message: Unzip it, move Maps Desktop to Applications and open it. The first time, macOS asks you to confirm: System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security ▸ Open Anyway.

missingPause.message: Don’t need the app? Click the extension button in Chrome’s toolbar to pause it, or remove the extension.

welTitle.message: The Maps Desktop extension is installed

welLead.message: Google Maps links you click in Chrome will open in the Maps Desktop app for Mac instead of a browser tab. Chrome stays your browser.

welStep1Text.message: The free, open-source Google Maps app for Mac (macOS 14 or later). Already have it? Go to step 2.

welStep2Text.message: Click Connect. Chrome asks “Open Maps Desktop?” — tick “Always allow” and click Open. Maps Desktop opens and confirms the connection.

connected.message: ✓ Connected. Map links from Chrome will open in Maps Desktop.

connectCancelled.message: You clicked Cancel. Click Connect again and choose Open.

connectMissing.message: Maps Desktop didn’t open. Install it (step 1), open it once and click Connect again.

howClick.message: Click any Google Maps link in Chrome — in mail, chats, search results — and it opens in Maps Desktop.

howTab.message: The first time, the extension asks whether to close the Chrome tab after the map opens in the app. You can change that in the extension options.

howPause.message: To pause or resume opening links in the app, click the extension button in Chrome’s toolbar (pin it from the puzzle-piece menu). “off” on the button means paused. The dark theme isn’t affected.

howChrome.message: Want a map in Chrome after all? In Maps Desktop choose File ▸ Open in Browser — the extension leaves that tab alone.

notMac.message: Maps Desktop is a Mac app, so on this computer the extension doesn’t open links in it. It gives Google Maps in Chrome a dark theme.

actionNotMac.message: Dark mode for Google Maps: right-click for the theme. Opening links in the Maps Desktop app works only on a Mac.

welTheme.message: Dark theme for Google Maps in Chrome

welThemeText.message: Google Maps in Chrome gets the same dark theme as the Maps Desktop app: the interface and the map, while photos, satellite view and Street View keep their colours.

actionOn.message: Opening map links in Maps Desktop: on. Click to pause; right-click for the Google Maps theme.

actionOff.message: Opening map links in Maps Desktop: paused. Click to resume; right-click for the Google Maps theme.

welThemeHow.message: By default the theme follows the system appearance. To keep Google Maps always light or always dark, right-click the extension button ▸ Google Maps theme.
